description: Ghani Value Glass Limited is a glass-processing company incorporated in Pakistan in 1967, listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange and part of the Ghani Group of Industries. It adds value to glass produced within the group — toughening, laminating, silvering and screen printing — making architectural safety glass, mirrors, home-appliance glass and bullet-resistant glass.
sourceNote: Company website (ghanivalueglass.com: about us, contact us) and the PSX Data Portal company record for GVGL, read 2026-10-17.
